blocks.text: [Updated Sept. 17, 2026, 2:28 p.m.] MANILA, Philippines — Sen. Robin Padilla shed tears of joy after former President Rodrigo Duterte made his first in-person appearance before the International Criminal Court (ICC) Trial Chamber III on Wednesday. It has been a year and a half since Duterte attended his proceedings in the Hague, which he previously only attended through online video conferencing. “I was shocked and unexpectedly shed tears of joy when I saw him. But I was also filled with sadness because I knew that Father Digong is a strong man,” Padilla said in a text message to the media. […]...
